'''General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike''' was a customized [[TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike]] owned by [[General]] [[Grievous]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]]. During the [[Standard day|final days]] of the [[Clone Wars]], Grievous utilized his wheel bike to escape [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on a [[varactyl]] named [[Boga]] on [[Utapau]], but Kenobi's varactyl mount kept up with the speedy vehicle while the General battled the [[Jedi Master]].

==Characteristics==
Originally designed as an off-road surveillance vehicle,<ref name ="Ships and Vehicles (2)">{{EncyclopediaCite|Miscellaneous Ships and Vehicles (2)}}</ref> [[General]] [[Grievous]]' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike<ref name="TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike">{{Databank|general-grievous-tsmeu-6-wheel-bike|General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike}}</ref> was a modified [[TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> designed to roll at a terrifying speed on hard surfaces<ref name="Complete Vehicles">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2016)]]</ref> and had four retractable [[Limb|legs]] placed beneath the seat, which, when deployed, allow the bike to handle difficult terrain, as well as elevate itself up on two pairs of legs to stroll over<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> battle wreckage and other obstacles. One side seat was swapped out for a double [[laser cannon]], and when Grievous enters battle, he can use either a conveniently positioned [[electrostaff]], a [[blaster]], or one of his [[lightsaber]]s.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

Grievous alwayed preferred to lead his forces from the front, giving him ample opportunities to display his martial skills. In this regard, no vehicle was better suited to his savage tactics than the TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike. In his pursuit of his [[Jedi]] prey, Grievous was able to cut a path through enemy ranks using his wheel bike's rugged and agile nature.<ref name="General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike">{{AtomicMassGames|url=character/grievous-wheel-bike|text=SWQ31 General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike}}</ref>

==History==
Grievous adapted his TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike into a vicious assault machine to [[Hunting|hunt]] down [[Jedi Knight]]s, his favored prey.<ref name ="Ships and Vehicles (2)" />

[[File:KenobipursuesGrievousonUtapau.png|thumb|255px|left|General Grievous pursued by Obi-Wan Kenobi on Utapau.]]
On the battlefield of [[Parein II]]'s [[Parein II 4|fourth moon]], Grievous used his TSMEU-6 wheel bike for the first time.<ref name ="Ships and Vehicles (2)" /> Grievous also used his wheel bike during the [[invasion of Utapau]].<ref name="TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike" /> In the final [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Clone Wars]] at the [[Battle of Utapau]], he attempted to flee using his wheel bike to reach his personal [[starfighter]], the ''[[Soulless One]]'', while being pursued by [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on a [[varactyl]] named [[Boga]]. Eventually, Grievous lost control, and the wheel bike rolled off into the [[sinkhole]] of [[Utapau]] and was destroyed.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" />
